paragraphs: Aruva. Rabbi Pinchas ben Aruva — Gittin 56b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied tractate label is ניטין. Gittin 56b in the William Davidson Edition – Vocalized Aramaic explicitly has רַבִּי פִּנְחָס בֶּן עֲרוּבָא; this supports Gittin and the expanded Rabbi title for this occurrence. The Hebrew source remains unchanged.
Aruva is a conventional vocalization of ערובא. The notice gives the parent-name heading, the named Pinchas ben Aruva and a citation; no further biography is supplied.
